cards.name: The Dark Door
cards.officialText: Only 1 monster can attack during each Battle Phase.

cards.name: Level Limit - Area B
cards.officialText: Change all face-up Level 4 or higher monsters to Defense Position.

behavior.darkDoor: One distinct attacking monster UID per team Battle Phase; the same monster may attack repeatedly. The first attacker remains the phase's permitted monster even if it leaves the field. A new Battle Phase gets a new ledger.
behavior.levelLimitAreaB: While any face-up copy exists in either team's backrow, all face-up Level 4+ monsters on both teams are changed to Defense Position. Face-down monsters are ignored until revealed; removing the final copy does not restore prior positions.
behavior.tagDuelScope: The Dark Door ledger is per team's Battle Phase, matching the shared 2v2 team turn. Level Limit - Area B affects both teams.
behavior.integration: Isolated adapter helpers only. No central resolver, tagActions, Discord commands, catalog, certification registry, or released-card allowlist changed.
